# CarBuzz

> > Automotive news and reviews covering muscle cars, luxury vehicles, motorsports, and classic car culture.

CarBuzz delivers breaking automotive news, vehicle comparisons, buying guides, and coverage of major events like Monterey Car Week. The site features content from automotive journalists including Ty Duffy, Evan Williams, and Kyle Francis, focusing on performance vehicles, limited editions, and industry trends.

## Key Topics

- Muscle cars and performance vehicles
- Hemi V8 engines and powertrains
- Luxury and limited-edition vehicles
- Monterey Car Week coverage
- Dodge Durango and Charger models
- Audi RS6 Avant
- McLaren supercars
- Nissan Z sports car
- Classic and rare vehicles
- Vehicle comparisons and reviews
- Used car buying guides
- Motorsports and racing
- European performance cars
- SUV and crossover news
- Automotive design and customization

- [The Nissan Z's Oldest Features Are What Make It Great](https://carbuzz.com/being-old-best-thing-nissan-z): Nissan Z's old platform and manual transmission praised as key strengths
- [This Classic Muscle Truck Costs The Same As Hyundai's Modern Budget Alternative](https://carbuzz.com/chevrolet-1970s-muscle-truck-same-price-as-hyundai-santa-cruz): 1970s Chevrolet El Camino V8 priced same as Hyundai Santa Cruz
